priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/socket.ts line 3 still returns an empty disposer after registering handler with socket.on; the PR diff removes the prior socket.off("message", handler) call, so cleanup continues to retain and invoke the listener.
